name: atlas-ade
description: Atlas ADE's own plugin: one skill that sets ADE up in your project.

plugins.name: atlas-ade
plugins.description: Sets up Atlas ADE, the meta-harness for your agentic workflows, in your project. ADE runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi on your repo one small task (a card) at a time: its own git worktree, a separate reviewer, tests, then merge. Shows what each card cost, so your usage goes on building. Free, MIT, no account.
